articles.title: Naruto Movie Closes in on Casting Hiroyuki Sanada as Live-Action Hiruzen Sarutobi
articles.summary: Hiroyuki Sanada has reportedly entered final negotiations to play Hiruzen Sarutobi in Destin Daniel Cretton's live-action Naruto movie. The Mortal Kombat and Shogun actor's potential role in the anime-to-film adaptation was first reported by Deadline.
body: How Sanada may help the iconic Hokage lead to the big screen remains to be seen. Meanwhile, the site's report stated that Charles Melton (Warfare, Beef Season 2), who was said to be in final negotiations to play Kakashi back in August, is still in talks to join Naruto.

The Spider-Man: Brand New Day director's shot at bringing one of the most beloved manga and anime properties of all time into the live-action realm is expected to begin filming sometime in spring 2027. With production right around the corner, though, Sony and Lionsgate have shared little about which actors have been picked to play some of the franchise's most important roles.

The only names we've heard so far are Melton and Sanada, and even their parts in the story haven't been outright confirmed just yet. Depending on what story Cretton and company hope to tell, there is still plenty of room for additional casting updates. Names like Sasuke, Sakura, and, of course, Naruto still have no names publicly attached, though that doesn't necessarily mean that stars haven't been picked behind the scenes.

articles.title: Family-Friendly Fortnite Streamer Goes Viral After Picking Up GTA 6 And Performing the Ultimate Heelturn, Including a Bloody Zoo Rampage
articles.summary: Nice-guy Fortnite streamer Nick Eh 30 has gone viral after trying GTA 6 — and immediately pushing the violence in Rockstar's game to its limit. For almost a decade, cheery Canadian streamer Nicholas " Nick Eh 30 " Amyoony has amassed a community of millions around his family-friendly Fortnite…
body: So it has, understandably, come as something of a surprise to see wholesome Nick Eh 30 embracing the most dastardly deeds GTA 6 has on offer: kicking pet dogs to death in the street, shooting animals in the zoo, and walking down the length of a train executing every passenger at point blank range.

As someone who has followed Nick Eh 30 for a while, seeing him wandering around GTA 6's world eliminating swathes of its animal population while chuckling to himself is indeed odd to see. Social media is awash with similar reactions, with posts from his followers stating things like: "IN WHAT UNIVERSE DO YOU NEED TO BE DOING THIS" and "Years of building ramps in Fortnite could not prepare chat for this."

But this is all clearly intentional, down to his streams being labelled as humorously promising "family friendly GTA" gameplay (I'm not sure there's any such thing). And the fact this has led people to actually discuss his streams and share clips further has only proven why he's likely doing this.

articles.title: Grand Theft Auto 6’s HDR Is Broken, But These Tweaks Can Fix It
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI is a visual and audial treat, and is easily one of the most technically impressive games on the current generation of consoles. But it isn't without issues, especially if you're trying to experience the sights and sounds of Vice City with all the moody contrast and bright…
body: That's due to an HDR calibration tool that isn't exactly working in the way that you expect it. Like many other games, GTA VI doesn't use the system-level HDR settings on either the PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X|S. Instead it features its own calibration tool, which lets you adjust the maximum brightness, black levels, and paper white values that work best on your display. While the tool makes calibration seem straightforward, there's an issue with it that makes it very unreliable.

Specifically, the maximum brightness and paper white point values seem to be linked in a way that is both unclear and incorrect. Normally you would set these values individually, with maximum brightness set according to the value your display supports and the paper white value that looks best to you. GTA VI instead changes the maximum peak brightness value it is storing as you change the paper white point. For example, if you set a maximum peak brightness at 1000 nits (a typical value) but then reduce the paper white point (given how how its default is), the peak brightness value reduces as well, with no indication to you that it's happening.
points: Grand Theft Auto VI is a visual and audial treat, and is easily one of the most technically impressive games on the current generation of consoles.

articles.title: Avengers: Doomsday Poster Gives Us Our Closest Look at Doctor Doom's Mask Yet
articles.summary: Marvel Studios has released a new Avengers: Doomsday poster that gives us our closest look at Doctor Doom's mask yet. Robert Downey Jr.'s Victor von Doom debut is almost here.
body: Considering all of the hubbub about Doctor Doom's different masks and costumes, it's nice to get a close-up of one of his most menacing looks and Downey Jr.'s dark green eye. You can see the full poster below.

Impressive details and rusty edges aside, many have also pointed out that there's more to this poster than meets the eye. No, there are no fun theories circulating about this one (yet), but it does continue to play into Downey Jr.'s ties to both Doctor Doom and his original Marvel Cinematic Universe hero, Iron Man.

One of the earliest MCU posters offered the same look at Iron Man's original Mark 3 design. Where Tony's poster gave audiences a new hero to take seriously, Doctor Doom's poster is more of a reminder of how far Marvel's heroes have come — and how far they still have to fall.

The reference is impossible to deny as fans continue to speculate how both of Downey Jr.'s characters may be connected. So far, Marvel has done its best to convince viewers that Doctor Doom is not a Tony Stark variant, but with posters like this only making the line between them darker, it's clear the MCU has more than a few fun surprises in store for next month.

articles.title: Steven Spielberg Teams Up With Cillian Murphy for New Western Written by Paul Thomas Anderson
articles.summary: Steven Spielberg is going big with his next film, which is a Western written by Paul Thomas Anderson and starring Cillian Murphy. Deadline confirmed that Spielberg is already developing his next film following the release of Disclosure Day this summer, and it'll be an adaptation of the 2024 novel…
body: Cillian Murphy and Jessie Buckley will play the leading characters in the film, which is apparently still untitled despite being sourced from an existing piece of work. He has also teamed with Oscar-winner Paul Thomas Anderson, who is penning the script. This marks the first time Anderson has fully written a script that he himself hasn't directed, but he has done uncredited punch-ups and rewrites on other movies like Killers of the Flower Moon.

“It’s really the excitement for me to get to work together with my dear friend and colleague Paul Thomas Anderson on a genre, but more particularly, the genre notwithstanding, a story that quite quickly became close to both our hearts and we felt that we could do as a team," said Spielberg about the partnership.

The two began flirting with the idea of working together back in January while Anderson was on the awards trail for One Battle After Another, which cleaned up at the various ceremonies and led to him receiving an Oscar for Best Adapted Screenplay. Naturally, that kind of prestige makes him a smart pick to adapt a layered novel such as this one. The two binged old Westerns on 35mm film as part of their creative process.

articles.summary: On the surface, Grand Theft Auto 6 has a pretty standard control scheme for its protagonists. You've got everything you'd expect for exploring its open-world environment, from options to sprint to aiming your gun, but there's a whole lot more to the game when you start experimenting with the…

Want to examine the world in more detail around you? Press L2 (LT on Xbox) to highlight something, then press R3 to go into first-person mode. Ordinarily, you can't move around in this mode, but there is a glitch to force the game to lock you into first-person.
Not too big a fan of the default over-the-shoulder aiming in GTA 6? You can switch which shoulder you aim from during combat by holding the left button on your D-pad while aiming with L2.

articles.title: GTA 6 Hacker Officially Walks Free After Judge's Final Warning
articles.summary: The man responsible for one of the biggest Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks is finally out of prison, and the judge had one very simple message for him: Don't do it again, mister.
body: Arion Kurtaj, now 21, was released under supervision after being sentenced to seven years in prison for a series of cybercrimes committed as a teenager, according to the BBC. The hacker, a member of the notorious Lapsus$ gang, pleaded guilty to breaking into several major companies, including Rockstar Games, Uber, and Revolut.

Kurtaj pulled off the Rockstar breach in 2022 while staying at a Travelodge in Bicester, England — and while under police protection and on bail for other hacking offenses. With his computer confiscated, he reportedly used an Amazon Fire Stick plugged into the hotel's television, along with a Bluetooth keyboard and mouse, to access Rockstar's internal systems.

He stole company data, including 90 clips showing nearly an hour of gameplay from the unfinished GTA 6. He then broke into Rockstar's Slack messaging system and threatened to release the game's source code unless the company contacted him on Telegram. When Rockstar refused, Kurtaj published the stolen material online under the username TeaPotUberHacker.
points: The man responsible for one of the biggest Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks is finally out of prison, and the judge had one very simple message for him: Don't do it again, mister.

articles.title: GTA 6 Has A Super Mario Bros. Easter Egg, And It’s A Trip
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 has plenty of fun Easter eggs --many of which tie back to earlier games in the series--but you can also find a few nods to other megapopular game franchises hiding within the vast map of Leonida.
body: Once you've arrived, scout the area for a purple tarp that has a bong sitting on it. Smoke it, get high, and climb the structure in front of you. You'll notice that there's a plume of smoke coming out of the one column, and if you stand in it, an invisible block will appear above your head.
Jump up, and you'll smash the block. You won't get any gold coins for your trouble, but you will get a nostalgic tune and two caps that reference Nintendo's favorite plumbers, Mario and Luigi.
Each cap has an initial embroidered on it: "J" for Jason, "L" for Lucia. You can add them to your collection, or leave them to gather dust; it's up to you.

As mentioned above, GTA 6 has references to a lot of pop culture. Someone at Rockstar Games is clearly a huge Dexter fan, Bigfoot is on the prowl, and I really wish I'd chosen the elevator without a killer clown inside it. For everything else on the biggest game of the year-- and maybe even the decade --check out GameSpot's GTA 6 guides hub.

articles.title: Activision calls Banjo-Kazooie one of its "iconic gaming franchises," raising hopes for long-awaited new game
articles.summary: Banjo-Kazooie - the iconic Rare platformer starring an absent-minded bear and the sassy red bird he carries in a backpack - has been on hiatus for years, but a new Activision job listing has raised hopes for a new game.
body: In a LinkedIn post advertising a 'Product Manager, Emergent Franchises' role, the publisher wrote that it's "home to iconic gaming franchises including Call of Duty, Crash Bandicoot, Spyro the Dragon, and now… Halo, Age of Empires, Sea of Thieves, and Banjo Kazooie."

"Become part of the team working on building, growing, and shaping many of these franchises," the listing goes on. "As a Product Manager, you will serve as the publishing product lead for an upcoming premium console & PC title, driving the product from concept to launch."

If you're scratching your brain trying to remember when Activision took control of the beloved platformer, well, it happened during Xbox's last massive internal shakeup. Amid the mass layoffs and studio divestments, Xbox also made some drastic changes to its corporate structure - Halo, World's Edge and Rare were all slotted under Activision's supervision.

Rare's 40-year history includes almost too many notable games to list, but the internal rejig presumably put Activision in control of games like Conker, Viva Pinata and Killer Instinct, alongside the aforementioned pirate hit Sea of Thieves and Banjo-Kazooie.

articles.title: Where to find the UFO dream house in GTA 6
articles.summary: If you're looking for the UFO dream house location in Grand Theft Auto 6, that means you've already seen the UFO itself once. This unmarked optional mission begins when you investigate an abandoned car at the side of the road, follow a trail of clothes strewn on the floor, then discover a woman in…
body: To continue the UFO storyline, you must find this unassuming building, located near a bridge and a rudimentary airstrip. If you want to know exactly where it is, you're in luck: I've found the UFO dream house location in GTA 6, so keep reading to learn where it is.

Even though the first UFO encounter happens in Port Gellhorn, the UFO dream house location is down south near Key Lento, where GTA 6 began. Specifically, it's directly north of Gambit Bay and south of Hamlet, a stone's throw northeast of the airstrip that is running north-to-south and is visible on the map.

If you approach by road, you'll see a brown sign for the Grassrivers Pelican Valley recreation area. Take a left and go through to Southpoint airfield, ignoring the signs for the restricted area. The gate is locked, but you can get through by running around to the left and jumping over part of the chainlink fence that doesn't have any barbed wire at the top. Go around to the other side of the building to find the front entrance.

articles.title: Should you give the statue to Benedict Halifax during 'Dubious Provenance' in GTA 6?
articles.summary: Giving the statue to Halifax during the Grand Theft Auto 6 "Dubious Provenance" mission may not seem like the wisest choice, but don't be too quick to decide. In this GTA 6 mission, one choice is more rewarding and more time-efficient than the other.
body: Here's what happens if you give the statue to Benedict Halifax in GTA 6, as well as advice for dealing with him later on.

"Dubious Provenance" is one of the early main missions in Chapter 3. After Cal visits Boobie's apartment at the end of the "Dealer's Choice" mission, you will see a mission icon in the closet next to the kitchen. It's a pink symbol of a statue. Grab this statue to get the "visit the antique store" objective and start "Dubious Provenance."

The GTA 6 "Dubious Provenance" mission takes you to an antiques store in Capri, where Jason and Lucia try to sell the statue they found in Chapter 1. The owner won't have anything to do with the statue, but as you leave the store, a shady fellow named Benedict Halifax will run after you and offer to help. You're faced with a choice: give the statue to Halifax, or refuse.

Besides missing out on the watch and delaying the story, refusing to give Halifax the statue unlocks the opportunity to skip the quest (since calling Halifax is an optional objective). You probably shouldn't skip the quest, though, as you'll miss an entertaining storyline with plenty of loot at the end, including a standout vehicle.
points: Giving the statue to Halifax during the Grand Theft Auto 6 "Dubious Provenance" mission may not seem like the wisest choice, but don't be too quick to decide.

articles.title: God of War Laufey's Faye actor jumps from games to live-action, as Amazon casts Deborah Ann Woll in upcoming series
articles.summary: After appearing in both God of War Ragnarok and next year's God of War Laufey, Deborah Ann Woll is about to reprise her role as Faye in Amazon Prime Video's upcoming live-action series.
body: Variety reports that the God of War cast list is now welcoming a second actor pulled straight from Sony Santa Monica's video game series. Deborah Ann Woll first showed up in the games as Kratos' wife and Atreus' mother during God of War Ragnarok, but she's also about to enter the spotlight proper in God of War Laufey.

Amazon's God of War cast now includes Dave Bautista (Guardians of the Galaxy) as god killer Kratos, Callum Vinson (Chucky) as Atreus, Mandy Patinkin as Odin and Ólafur Darri Ólafsson as Thor. Alastair Duncan is also making the game-to-show jump by stepping back into the figurative shoes of chatty head Mimir.

Earlier in the year, the God of War show halted production when former Kratos actor Ryan Hurst suffered an on-set injury. Bautista soon took over the role and production began again in October - all of Hurst's scenes had to be reshot, of course.

There's no release date yet for the show, but it's said to follow the Norse era of the games which began in 2018's more serious and stern revamp. Amazon ordered a two-season run for the show, which apparently means both seasons will be filmed back-to-back.

articles.title: What is the laptop password in GTA 6.
articles.summary: There's a laptop that needs a password in the bedroom of your Chapter 3 apartment in Grand Theft Auto 6. When you try to use the laptop, you need to choose the password from a few different options, but none of the options seem right.
body: Here's how to work out what the laptop password is in GTA 6, or if you want to just know the answer without working it out, we have the password itself explained too.

To work out what the laptop password is in GTA 6, you need to inspect two different items lying around the apartment. The first of these is found on the small table in the hallway: a photo frame dedicated to a dog called Muffins. Pick it up to examine it, then put it back down.

Next, look at the notepad on the dresser next to the bed, in front of the photo wall. Pick it up and you'll see a drawing of Muffins, relaxing on a throne, wearing a tiara, and holding a drink. Flip it over and the writing says "Class of '15 reunion next Friday."

Now, you can interact with the laptop and see the actual password options. You'll need to use the information you've learned to work out the laptop password. The password is composed of the dog's name, what she is, and the class year.

articles.title: Dawn of War 4's newest trailer teases the appearance of a fan-favourite character in the game's post-launch DLC
articles.summary: As Dawn of War 4 's December release date inches ever closer, a new trailer appears to have teased a fan-favourite character's inclusion in the RTS's first post-launch DLC.
body: The trailer, which covers the Commander Edition of Dawn of War 4, includes a breakdown of all the extra stuff packed in alongside this version of the game. This includes the digital soundtrack, three-days of early-access to the game, and the story prologue. It'll also include the Aftermath post-launch DLC too, with its dedicated campaign and new playable faction.

Now, ever since the Aftermath DLC was announced, people have speculated it would be chaos-focused. The design of the DLC logo is black with a gold trim, an often-used colour scheme for the faction. However, which sort of Chaos was left up to debate. That is, until this trailer, where the answer is seemingly given away with a cheeky tease.

In its final few seconds, the trailer shows a pair of glowing yellow mechanical eyes peering out from a gloomy background. This was quickly identified as almost-certainly Vashtorr the Arkifane, a relatively new addition to Warhammer 40,000 and a fan-favourite baddie all around.

body: The biggest game of the decade has arrived.
